notes.title: Quash v1.0 - Multiplayer & New Game Modes
notes.content:
Dear players,

Quash's early access is finally over and we're excited to announce and release the full version and our biggest update.

Patch Note:

 Added Multiplayer (Create private rooms and share the code to your friends to play in a multiplayer lobby)
 Added an integrated Voice Chat for multiplayer lobbies.
 Added 3 new game modes in the singleplayer campaign
            + Rebound : Use the side walls to be able to hit the bricks.
            + Sudden Death : Missing a shot will make you instantly lose.
            + Time Attack : Limited time to complete a layer.
 Various fixes and tweaks.


Join our Discord server to report bugs, give feedbacks and discuss directly with us!

Good luck, and we hope you will enjoy your play time.
